1.text: Zaburi iyi yahimbiwe umutware w'abaririmbyi babwira inanga. Ni Zaburi ya Dawidi yahimbishijwe ubwenge.

2.text: Mana, tegera ugutwi gusenga kwanjye,Ntiwirengagize kwinginga kwanjye.

3.text: Nyitaho unsubize,Kwiganyira bintera gukora hirya no hino, bikanihisha,

4.text: Ku bw'ijwi ry'umwanzi,Ku bw'agahato k'abanyabyaha,Kuko banteza amakuba,Bakangenzanya umujinya.

5.text: Umutima wanjye urambabaza cyane,Ubwoba bwinshi bunguyeho nk'ubw'ūtinya urupfu.

6.text: Gutinya no guhinda imishyitsi bingezeho,Gukangarana kuramiranije.

7.text: Ndavuga nti “Icyampa nkagira amababa nk'inuma,Mba ngurutse nkaruhuka.

8.text: Dore mba ndorongotaniye kure,Nkarara mu butayu.Sela.

9.text: Mba mpungiye vuba mu buhungiro,Nkikinga umuyaga w'ishuheri n'umugaru.”

10.text: Mwami, ubamire uyoberanye indimi zabo,Kuko nabonye urugomo no kurwana mu mudugudu.

11.text: Ku manywa na nijoro bigendagenda hejuru y'inkike zawo,Kandi gukiranirwa n'igomwa biri hagati yawo.

12.text: Gukora ibyaha kuri hagati yawo,Agahato n'uburiganya ntibiva mu nzira zo muri wo.

13.text: Si umwanzi wantutse,Mba narabashije kwihangana,Cyangwa uwanyangaga si we wanyirase hejuru,Mba naramwihishe.

14.text: Ahubwo ni wowe uwo duhwanye,Uwo twagendanaga, incuti yanjye y'amagara.

15.text: Twaganiraga tunezerewe,Tukagendagendana n'iteraniro mu nzu y'Imana.

16.text: Urupfu rubatungure,Bamanuke bajye ikuzimu bakiri bazima,Kuko gukora ibyaha kuri mu mazu yabo no mu mitima yabo.

18.text: Nimugoroba no mu gitondo no ku manywa y'ihangu,Nzajya muganyira niha,Na we azumva ijwi ryanjye.

19.text: Yacunguriye ubugingo bwanjye amahoro,Kugira ngo batanyegera,Kuko abandwanyaga ari benshi.

20.text: Imana izanyumva ibacishe bugufi,Ni yo ihora yicaye ku ntebe y'ubwami uhereye kera kose,Sela.Izacisha bugufi abadahindurwa ntibubahe Imana.

21.text: Wa muntu yaramburiye amaboko kubuza abo babanaga amahoro,Yahumanije isezerano rye.

22.text: Akanwa ke kanyereraga nk'amavuta,Ariko umutima we wibwiraga intambara gusa.Amagambo ye yoroheraga kurusha amavuta ya elayo,Ariko yari inkota zikūwe.

23.text: Ikoreze Uwiteka umutwaro wawe na we azakuramira,Ntabwo azakundira umukiranutsi kunyeganyezwa.

24.text: Ariko wowe Mana, uzabamanurira mu rwobo rw'irimbukiro,Abicanyi n'abariganya ntibazacagasa iminsi yo kubaho kwabo,Ariko jyeweho nzajya nkwiringira.
